sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Kind A. kann heute leider nicht zum Training kommen. :: Child A. sadly cannot come to training today. Das Training beginnt um 17.45 Uhr. :: Training starts at 5:45 pm. Beim nächsten Training ist er wieder dabei. :: He'll be there again at the next training.

sections.heading: Pronunciation
sections.text: Said the English way: TRAI-ning , with a German r .
